$comment: Source files that read or write autoResumeAt, each with its reason (hearsay-tools/cezarion#1496). Tests build fixtures freely. Add a file only with its reason; npm run lint fails an entry whose file no longer reads the time. The cez/run-fact-reader rule reads this list.

files.packages/contract/src/waits.ts: names the usage-limit wait by its time
files.packages/cezar/src/runs/loaded-run-exits: restores a schema-7 failed row that kept its resume time as the waiting hold
files.packages/cezar/src/runs/record-write-rul: stages the commit, loaded and debounced stale-resume write rules
files.packages/cezar/src/workflows/run/auto-re: arms, re-arms, withdraws and clears the resume timer at its time
files.packages/cezar/src/workflows/run-schedul: derives account holds from future resume deadlines
files.packages/cezar/src/workflows/run/run-lin: queue rescue reads the resume time
files.packages/cezar/src/runs/run-row.ts: the live column keeps an older row with a stale time live, so the store can heal it
prints the resume time beside the usage-limit label
files.packages/web/src/lib/run-row-meta.ts: prints the time until the resume
files.packages/web/src/lib/tasks-table.ts: prints the resume time in the status cell
files.packages/web/src/lib/task-groups.ts: orders two holds by their resume times
files.packages/web/src/routes/task-thread/auto: prints the resume time in the thread hint
